meta.title: Echoes of Distant Memory - 2
meta.description: In the name of salvation, all shall be as it was.

units.rawText: In the Pantheon of the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: In the Pantheon of the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: In the Pantheon of the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: Gold and purple operands crash against Persicaria's operand barrier and cracks spread from the gap in it.
units.displayText: Gold and purple operands crash against Persicaria's operand barrier and cracks spread from the gap in it.

spans.text: Gold and purple operands crash against Persicaria's operand barrier and cracks spread from the gap in it.

units.rawText: And this is with the Overwrite Program's help... I can't believe mere memory data has so much power...
units.displayText: And this is with the Overwrite Program's help... I can't believe mere memory data has so much power...

spans.text: And this is with the Overwrite Program's help... I can't believe mere memory data has so much power...

units.rawText:
Over the course of the long battle, Persicaria's core grows hotter, almost burning her.
Meanwhile, two dramatically different operand types intertwine in Eosphorus' body. He hovers in the air above the Pantheon, like a fallen angel descending upon the mortal world.
units.displayText:
Over the course of the long battle, Persicaria's core grows hotter, almost burning her.
Meanwhile, two dramatically different operand types intertwine in Eosphorus' body. He hovers in the air above the Pantheon, like a fallen angel descending upon the mortal world.

spans.text:
Over the course of the long battle, Persicaria's core grows hotter, almost burning her.
Meanwhile, two dramatically different operand types intertwine in Eosphorus' body. He hovers in the air above the Pantheon, like a fallen angel descending upon the mortal world.

units.rawText: The collapse of the outside world has started eating into the Reverse Tower, and both past and present are about to be buried here.
units.displayText: The collapse of the outside world has started eating into the Reverse Tower, and both past and present are about to be buried here.

spans.text: The collapse of the outside world has started eating into the Reverse Tower, and both past and present are about to be buried here.

units.rawText: I will have you answer for this with your deaths.
units.displayText: I will have you answer for this with your deaths.

spans.text: I will have you answer for this with your deaths.

units.rawText: Eosphorus swings his sword again, but I and the object that I'm tightly clutching in my hand have been waiting for this moment.
units.displayText: Eosphorus swings his sword again, but I and the object that I'm tightly clutching in my hand have been waiting for this moment.

spans.text: Eosphorus swings his sword again, but I and the object that I'm tightly clutching in my hand have been waiting for this moment.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, stop.
units.displayText: Eosphorus, stop.

spans.text: Eosphorus, stop.

units.rawText: Stop? You're wrong, <cmdr> ...All this has been decided long ago. I have never seen my destiny this clearly before.
units.displayText: Stop? You're wrong, {교수} ...All this has been decided long ago. I have never seen my destiny this clearly before.

spans.text: Stop? You're wrong,
...All this has been decided long ago. I have never seen my destiny this clearly before.

units.rawText: I know that bound by the revelations as you are, you cannot understand the decision that I have made. But be at ease. I will take good care of your Sacred Canon... so that you will bear witness to everything when the day comes.
units.displayText: I know that bound by the revelations as you are, you cannot understand the decision that I have made. But be at ease. I will take good care of your Sacred Canon... so that you will bear witness to everything when the day comes.

spans.text: I know that bound by the revelations as you are, you cannot understand the decision that I have made. But be at ease. I will take good care of your Sacred Canon... so that you will bear witness to everything when the day comes.

units.rawText: Eosphorus raises his sword and points it at Persicaria.
units.displayText: Eosphorus raises his sword and points it at Persicaria.

spans.text: Eosphorus raises his sword and points it at Persicaria.

units.rawText: Don't think that we will remain puppets of the gods forever!
units.displayText: Don't think that we will remain puppets of the gods forever!

spans.text: Don't think that we will remain puppets of the gods forever!

units.rawText: Professor... Get behind me.
units.displayText: Professor... Get behind me.

spans.text: Professor... Get behind me.

units.rawText: Persicaria holds her sword before herself to shelter me and gathers her operands around her blade. Everything around us vanishes into nothingness; only Persicaria and Eosphorus are still shining.
units.displayText: Persicaria holds her sword before herself to shelter me and gathers her operands around her blade. Everything around us vanishes into nothingness; only Persicaria and Eosphorus are still shining.

spans.text: Persicaria holds her sword before herself to shelter me and gathers her operands around her blade. Everything around us vanishes into nothingness; only Persicaria and Eosphorus are still shining.

units.rawText: The final collapse... is upon us.
units.displayText: The final collapse... is upon us.

spans.text: The final collapse... is upon us.

units.rawText: Faster... Work faster... I need your help, Eos.
units.displayText: Faster... Work faster... I need your help, Eos.

spans.text: Faster... Work faster... I need your help, Eos.

units.rawText: I'm here, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I'm here, {교수}.

spans.text: I'm here,

units.rawText: The quiet whisper I haven't heard for so long speaks once again, and the earring in my hand begins to grow hot. Like the first rays of dawn, it ignites hope in my heart.
units.displayText: The quiet whisper I haven't heard for so long speaks once again, and the earring in my hand begins to grow hot. Like the first rays of dawn, it ignites hope in my heart.

spans.text: The quiet whisper I haven't heard for so long speaks once again, and the earring in my hand begins to grow hot. Like the first rays of dawn, it ignites hope in my heart.

units.rawText: This time, what kind of puzzle will you piece together, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: This time, what kind of puzzle will you piece together, {교수}?

spans.text: This time, what kind of puzzle will you piece together,

units.rawText: I move to Persicaria's side and press the keepsake to her sword.
units.displayText: I move to Persicaria's side and press the keepsake to her sword.

spans.text: I move to Persicaria's side and press the keepsake to her sword.

units.rawText: <size=40>Professor!</size>
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: I cover Persicaria's hands with my own and take hold of the sword's hilt with her. The light of dawn extends over the blade as the endlessly shifting data drives the weapon's base layer through cycle after cycle of frenzied iteration.
units.displayText: I cover Persicaria's hands with my own and take hold of the sword's hilt with her. The light of dawn extends over the blade as the endlessly shifting data drives the weapon's base layer through cycle after cycle of frenzied iteration.

spans.text: I cover Persicaria's hands with my own and take hold of the sword's hilt with her. The light of dawn extends over the blade as the endlessly shifting data drives the weapon's base layer through cycle after cycle of frenzied iteration.

units.rawText: Are you ready?
units.displayText: Are you ready?

spans.text: Are you ready?

units.rawText: Yes. This will be the final blow.
units.displayText: Yes. This will be the final blow.

spans.text: Yes. This will be the final blow.

units.rawText: Eosphorus raises his sword. Pain flashes through his eyes, but then they grow steady again.
units.displayText: Eosphorus raises his sword. Pain flashes through his eyes, but then they grow steady again.

spans.text: Eosphorus raises his sword. Pain flashes through his eyes, but then they grow steady again.

units.rawText: In the end, you still stand by their side, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: In the end, you still stand by their side, {교수}.

spans.text: In the end, you still stand by their side,

units.rawText: No matter. Only by destroying you will Magrasea have a new future.
units.displayText: No matter. Only by destroying you will Magrasea have a new future.

spans.text: No matter. Only by destroying you will Magrasea have a new future.

units.rawText: Each upholding our own convictions, we pause, then push off, and break into a run toward each other at the end of the light.
units.displayText: Each upholding our own convictions, we pause, then push off, and break into a run toward each other at the end of the light.

spans.text: Each upholding our own convictions, we pause, then push off, and break into a run toward each other at the end of the light.

units.rawText: <size=40>CLANG—</size>
units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.rawText: The swords collide with a cacophonous crash, and the hurricane of operands between them rips apart everything around us.
units.displayText: The swords collide with a cacophonous crash, and the hurricane of operands between them rips apart everything around us.

spans.text: The swords collide with a cacophonous crash, and the hurricane of operands between them rips apart everything around us.

units.rawText: The entire domain heats up from the energy of the clash and our clothes begin to melt from the heat. The only thing that remains unchanged is the certainty on our faces.
units.displayText: The entire domain heats up from the energy of the clash and our clothes begin to melt from the heat. The only thing that remains unchanged is the certainty on our faces.

spans.text: The entire domain heats up from the energy of the clash and our clothes begin to melt from the heat. The only thing that remains unchanged is the certainty on our faces.

units.rawText: You cannot use the pain of reality as an excuse for falling.
units.displayText: You cannot use the pain of reality as an excuse for falling.

spans.text: You cannot use the pain of reality as an excuse for falling.

units.rawText: <size=40>You were a symbol of hope; yet you surrendered to the darkness! Eosphorus, you have sinned!</size>
units.displayText: You were a symbol of hope; yet you surrendered to the darkness! Eosphorus, you have sinned!

spans.text: You were a symbol of hope; yet you surrendered to the darkness! Eosphorus, you have sinned!

units.rawText: <size=40>Crash—</size>
units.displayText: Crash—

spans.text: Crash—

units.rawText: The immense pressure causes sparks to fly from the intersecting blades.
units.displayText: The immense pressure causes sparks to fly from the intersecting blades.

spans.text: The immense pressure causes sparks to fly from the intersecting blades.

units.rawText: <size=40>What would the gods who watch from on high know about the weight and meaning of existence?!</size>
units.displayText: What would the gods who watch from on high know about the weight and meaning of existence?!

spans.text: What would the gods who watch from on high know about the weight and meaning of existence?!

units.rawText: <size=40>How many Sanctifiers, how many agents do you think have been born, fought, and died for such a laughable reason?!</size>
units.displayText: How many Sanctifiers, how many agents do you think have been born, fought, and died for such a laughable reason?!

spans.text: How many Sanctifiers, how many agents do you think have been born, fought, and died for such a laughable reason?!

units.rawText: Do you even understand this fact... <size=60>THIS TRUTH?!</size>
units.displayText: Do you even understand this fact... THIS TRUTH?!

spans.text: Do you even understand this fact...
THIS TRUTH?!

units.rawText: Eosphorus steps forward with a furious shout, but then there is a quiet sigh in his ear.
units.displayText: Eosphorus steps forward with a furious shout, but then there is a quiet sigh in his ear.

spans.text: Eosphorus steps forward with a furious shout, but then there is a quiet sigh in his ear.

units.rawText: Can you no longer hear my voice, Eosphorus?
units.displayText: Can you no longer hear my voice, Eosphorus?

spans.text: Can you no longer hear my voice, Eosphorus?

units.rawText: Don't let anger seep into your neural cloud. You should be the pole star that calmly leads the masses.
units.displayText: Don't let anger seep into your neural cloud. You should be the pole star that calmly leads the masses.

spans.text: Don't let anger seep into your neural cloud. You should be the pole star that calmly leads the masses.

units.rawText: ...What...
units.displayText: ...What...

spans.text: ...What...

units.rawText: Eosphorus reflexively flinches and the force of his grip lessens slightly, and for a moment he seems to see someone who ought to have been gone.
units.displayText: Eosphorus reflexively flinches and the force of his grip lessens slightly, and for a moment he seems to see someone who ought to have been gone.

spans.text: Eosphorus reflexively flinches and the force of his grip lessens slightly, and for a moment he seems to see someone who ought to have been gone.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>Eos...?</color>
units.displayText: Eos...?

spans.text: Eos...?

units.rawText: Crack...
units.displayText: Crack...

spans.text: Crack...

units.rawText: The sound of splintering and this sudden lapse in focus is fatal. The two swords ought to have been equal, but there are now faint cracks in Eosphorus' blade.
units.displayText: The sound of splintering and this sudden lapse in focus is fatal. The two swords ought to have been equal, but there are now faint cracks in Eosphorus' blade.

spans.text: The sound of splintering and this sudden lapse in focus is fatal. The two swords ought to have been equal, but there are now faint cracks in Eosphorus' blade.

units.rawText: Eosphorus realizes this and comes to his senses. His eyes grow more determined than before as he channels all the strength in his body into this exchange of blows.
units.displayText: Eosphorus realizes this and comes to his senses. His eyes grow more determined than before as he channels all the strength in his body into this exchange of blows.

spans.text: Eosphorus realizes this and comes to his senses. His eyes grow more determined than before as he channels all the strength in his body into this exchange of blows.

units.rawText: <size=60>MAGRASEA WILL BE FREE!</size>
units.displayText: MAGRASEA WILL BE FREE!

spans.text: MAGRASEA WILL BE FREE!

units.rawText: Even if...!
units.displayText: Even if...!

spans.text: Even if...!

units.rawText: His words die in his throat. One sword shatters another, and then it cleaves Eosphorus in two.
units.displayText: His words die in his throat. One sword shatters another, and then it cleaves Eosphorus in two.

spans.text: His words die in his throat. One sword shatters another, and then it cleaves Eosphorus in two.

units.rawText: He falls like a puppet whose strings have been cut, then sinks and vanishes into the nothingness along with the shattered realm around us, leaving nothing but whispered words in the void.
units.displayText: He falls like a puppet whose strings have been cut, then sinks and vanishes into the nothingness along with the shattered realm around us, leaving nothing but whispered words in the void.

spans.text: He falls like a puppet whose strings have been cut, then sinks and vanishes into the nothingness along with the shattered realm around us, leaving nothing but whispered words in the void.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>We must betray the gods...</color>
units.displayText: We must betray the gods...

spans.text: We must betray the gods...

units.rawText: Answer her call. Build the picture that exists in your heart, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Answer her call. Build the picture that exists in your heart, {교수}.

spans.text: Answer her call. Build the picture that exists in your heart,
